concerns.text: Task T015 references 'data/processed/connectivity_matrices/' without specifying *how* to verify the contents.  Needs a concrete verification step (e.g., check dimensions, non-NaN values).
Task T016 only mentions *verifying* formula constraints, but doesn't specify the acceptable deviation threshold. This needs to be defined for a clear pass/fail criterion.
